variants.text: face oblong shape; facial thirds balanced; bone structure defined; forehead high and moderately wide; horizontal creases prominent; hairline receding at temples; brow ridge moderate; eyebrows low and soft-arched; eyes almond-shaped with moderate upper-lid exposure; orbital depth deep-set; nasal bridge straight; nasal tip slightly downturned and bulbous; alar width moderate; mouth medium-width; lips thin; mouth corners level; philtrum short with defined ridges; jawline sharp with moderate angularity; chin rounded; ears moderate size with attached lobes positioned level with eye-nose line; hair short grey and styled back; mustache short grey; head tilt slight upward.

Short grey hair styled back and a short grey mustache accompany an oblong facial shape with defined bone structure. The forehead is high and moderately wide with prominent horizontal creases and a receding hairline at the temples. The face features low, soft-arched eyebrows over almond-shaped eyes with deep-set orbital depth and moderate upper-lid exposure. The nose has a straight bridge and a slightly downturned, bulbous tip with moderate alar width. The mouth is medium-width with thin lips and level corners, situated below a short philtrum with defined ridges. The sharp jawline leads to a rounded chin, with moderate-sized ears featuring attached lobes positioned level with the eye-nose line.
